answer: Sybil resistance can come from time, not money: every identity must finish a sequential delay proof each epoch, a 40-minute chain of hashes seeded by its address, the way basalt layers form slowly and can't be rushed. Cores don't speed it up, so 1,000 fake keys need 1,000 dedicated cores, about $50 per core-month. A yarrow-small farm can't hide; the plume of cost scales linearly.
